QuestInfo.name: The Stolen Diary
QuestInfo.0: Ask Winston what he took from Chromile's tent.
QuestInfo.1: The diary Winston took from Chromile's Tent was stolen by monsters. You need to investigate #b50 Stumps#k to check the diary. Stumps can be found in #m102020000#.
QuestInfo.2: You took on Winston's request and investigated 50 Stumps, but there was no diary. Listen to what Winston has to say.
QuestInfo.parent: Where in Maple World is Chromile the Knight?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 2,300
#i1002058:# #t1002058:# x 1
Can proceed to The True Culprit?

0.0: I'm assuming you WANT something again? \r\n#L0##bYou took something out of the old tent on Gusty Peak. Those were my father's belongings. Give them to me.#l\n#k
0.1: Your FATHER? Are you trying to tell me Chromile was your father? That is preposterous.\r\n#L0##bIt is the truth. Now give me back his things.#l\n#k
0.2: Where's your proof? His diaries are full of great research. Chromile was a collector, like me. His diaries and research materials belong here! Now, I am not totally without heart... I will allow you to LOOK at his things. For a while. Not long. And wash your hands.\r\n#L0# #bI really need his diary. Please let me see it.#l\n#k
0.3: You've made the right decision. Unfortunately, I lied when I said the diary was here. A monster stole it from me three days ago. I believe it was one of the #b#eStumps#k#n, but I didn't actually see it happen. If you want to see that diary, 'investigate' 50 Stumps. I'm sure it will show up.\r\n#e#b(If you accept, you'll travel to #m102020000# automatically.)#k#n

no.0: Is that it? You can't expect me to believe you're related to Chromile if you can't give me ANY proof. I'm a man of science!

1.0: Why are your hands as empty as your head? Where is the diary?\r\n#L0##bNone of the Stumps had it. It must have been another monster...#l\n#k
1.1: Another monster? It could only be...
